Name: Tenkai Safe Decorating - Furniture Lock
Author: TENKAITENSHI
Description:
[size=5][b]Decorate when you want. Keep your furniture where it belongs.[/b][/size]

Have you ever picked up your bed, a painting or a lamp while trying to do something else? Tenkai Safe Decorating adds a simple furniture lock to Stardew Valley, so everyday clicks do not rearrange your home.

Furniture starts locked. Press [b]F7[/b] to enable editing, arrange your room, then press F7 again to lock it. You do not need to hold the key.

[b]What it does[/b]
[list]
[*]Prevents picking up, placing and rotating placed furniture while editing is locked.[/*]
[*]Covers beds, chairs, paintings, lamps, windows, rugs and other items that the game classifies as Furniture.[/*]
[*]Also protects decorative furniture placed on tables.[/*]
[*]Replaces the furniture pickup-hand icon with the normal cursor while locked. Enabling editing restores the game's normal hover behavior.[/*]
[*]Supports farmhouses, cabins and other decoratable interiors.[/*]
[*]Resets to locked when a save is loaded or a new day starts. Leaving and re-entering a room keeps the current mode for that day.[/*]
[*]Includes English and Spanish messages, selected through the game's language.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Your furniture remains usable[/b]
The lock targets furniture movement. Normal furniture interactions keep their original behavior: sleeping in beds, sitting, using a TV, operating a fireplace, opening a catalogue or accessing storage furniture. Ordinary items placed on tables remain interactable; decorative Furniture items on tables require editing mode to be picked up.

[b]Controls[/b]
Press F7 inside a supported interior. An on-screen message confirms whether editing is enabled or furniture is locked.

To change the button, launch the game once, close it, and edit the mod's config.json:
[code]{ "ToggleEditKey": "F7" }[/code]Replace F7 with another SMAPI button name. This setting is changed through the file; an in-game configuration menu is not included.

[b]Requirements and installation[/b]
Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. This package targets Stardew Valley 1.6 and declares SMAPI 4.0.0 or later; the captured environment is Windows, Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2.

Extract the TenkaiDecoracionSegura folder from the ZIP into Stardew Valley/Mods, then start the game through SMAPI. Preserve your existing config.json when updating. No Content Patcher or additional content pack is required.

[b]Optional Harem Love integration[/b]
The mod exposes the current lock state and configured toggle key for Harem Love's furniture integration. Harem Love is optional and is downloaded separately. Custom integrations depend on the version of the other mod.

[b]Scope and compatibility[/b]
Chests, machines, object-type torches, wallpaper and flooring are outside this furniture lock. Other mods that directly change furniture positions or remove furniture may bypass it.

Each player needs this mod to protect their own actions. Editing state is stored separately per screen, but real multiplayer and split-screen sessions have not been fully validated. Android, consoles and other desktop systems were not tested for this package.

[b]Removal and save data[/b]
Close the game and remove Mods/TenkaiDecoracionSegura. This mod adds no items and writes no custom data to your save.

[b]Screenshots and credits[/b]
The gallery uses staged scenes rendered by the actual game engine, with the released mod's lock and cursor behavior. It does not show a personal save. Text panels and enlarged cursor samples explain the demonstration; they are not additional in-game menus.

Mod author: [b]Tenkai Tenshi[/b]. Stardew Valley and the vanilla furniture artwork belong to ConcernedApe. No AI-generated screenshots are used.
